approvalEvidence.statement: The user explicitly approved the seven normalized acceptance criteria (AC-001..AC-007) below as an approved change to the baseline. These AC are embodied and verified in the committed feature features/workspace/ide-packaging.feature (scenario REQ-IDE-PACKAGING-001) and the driver tests/story/support/ide-packaging.ts at HEAD.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The fixed packaging command pnpm --filter @ide/desktop tauri build --bundles appimage --ci exits with code 0 and produces a real release AppImage artifact.
The artifact exists at the fixed path apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/appimage/IDE_0.1.0_amd64.AppImage.
The artifact has fixed product name IDE and fixed version 0.1.0.
The artifact is executable and self-contained (ELF magic 7f454c46 plus AppImage type-2 magic AI).
Launching the artifact starts the IDE desktop and its native window becomes ready (x11 window with WM_NAME IDE).
Closing the IDE window makes the packaged app exit cleanly.
Zero IDE desktop processes survive after exit.

requirement.initialIntent: Produce a real, verifiable AppImage package of the IDE desktop application that runs on CachyOS/Arch (portable Linux) while preserving the existing release/no-bundle native evidence and the REQ-PI-WORKSPACE-AGENT-001 status.

qualityConstraints: Deliver one complete packaging milestone; do not present an intermediate build-config-only slice as finished.
Use focused tests during implementation and one integrated end-to-end acceptance at completion.
Native executable selection and bundle arguments must remain fixed; never interpolate project data into shell command strings.
Keep the existing desktop/web architecture and REQ-PI-WORKSPACE-AGENT-001 status unchanged by this slice.
Generated artifacts and user-facing product text remain English.
exclusions: deb/rpm/pacman native packages and custom PKGBUILD
Windows/MSI/NSIS packaging (blocked: requires a Windows host or CI runner)
Code signing, installer branding, or distribution/store publication
Installing, removing, or updating Pi packages, or unrelated repository cleanup
approvedChanges: Scope approved by the user: Linux AppImage packaging only, targeted at CachyOS/Arch portable use; deb/rpm/pacman and Windows packaging remain excluded/blocked.
